mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( login_email, password_hash, user_name, phone_number, birth_date, user_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{loginEmail}, #{passwordHash}, #{userName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{birthDate}, #{userStatus}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_email, password_hash, user_name, phone_number, birth_date, user_status, created_at, updated_at FROM user WHERE login_email=#{loginEmail} LIMIT 1
